title: InternalStartTest
description: Body of POST /internal/tests (server-main -> test-control). Internal, loopback-only, no auth. server-main has already assigned test_id and validated the device; test-control allocates ports and coordinates generators from here.

server_host.description: Reachable server address the device will connect to; held by server-main as deployment config and passed through to the assembled RunTestPayload.

plan.description: Port-less plan. test-control allocates a port per flow (flow_bindings).
